originalContent.title: SEED Scheme (Scheme for Economic Empowerment of DNT):
originalContent.summary: Schemes — SEED Scheme (Scheme for Economic Empowerment of DNT):

items: The SEED Scheme is designed to uplift Denotified Tribes (DNTs) by providing essential support in
key areas:
o Educational Support: Free coaching for competitive exams and skill development.
o Health Coverage: Health insurance for DNT families to cover medical expenses.
o Economic Assistance: Financial aid for livelihood creation and small business ventures.
o Housing Support: Assistance in constructing safe and secure homes.
Eligibility: Families with an annual income of less than ₹2.5 lakhs.
The scheme aims to enhance the socio-economic status of DNT communities by improving access to
education, healthcare, livelihood opportunities, and housing.

blocks.title: SEED Scheme (Scheme for Economic Empowerment of DNT/NT/SNT Communities)
blocks.summary: To provide comprehensive socio-economic upliftment, quality coaching, health insurance, livelihood assistance, and housing support to De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNT/NT/SNT) not classified under SC/ST/OBC.

rows: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Development and Welfare Board for De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities (DWBDNC)
100% Central Sector Scheme with funds transferred directly via DBT to beneficiaries / implementing bodies.
Development and Welfare Board for DNTs (DWBDNC) in coordination with National Health Authority (NHA) and National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM).

items: **Target Beneficiaries:** Members of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes across India.
**Eligibility Criteria:** Families belonging to identified DNT/NT/SNT communities with total annual family income not exceeding ₹2.50 Lakh per annum.
Four Core Pillars:
1. Free Coaching: Financial support for civil services, banking, insurance, defense, and NEET/JEE coaching.
2. Health Insurance: Comprehensive health coverage under PM-JAY (₹5.00 Lakh/family/year).
3. Livelihood Initiatives: Financial assistance and cluster formation via DAY-NRLM / SHGs.
4. Housing Support: Special financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh (plains) / ₹1.30 Lakh (hills) under PMAY-Gramin.
Nodal Board: DWBDNC (Development and Welfare Board for DNT/NT/SNT Communities).
Outlay: ₹200 Crore over 5 years.
Four distinct pillars: Coaching, Health Insurance (PM-JAY), Livelihoods (NRLM), Housing (PMAY).
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, SEED Portal & Launch Notification (seed.dosje.gov.in)
PIB Delhi, "Union Minister Launches SEED Scheme for Welfare of DNT Communities" (16-Feb-2022)
